title: Core Term of a New Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Payment Arrangement
content:
**Decision table.** The arrangement term of a new monthly payment arrangement on an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account is built on a core term set by the account's situation, read in the order below.

| Account's situation | Core term |
|---|---|
| The account's hardship approval is in force | the months still left in that approval: the hardship approval term (12 calendar months in every payer class) less the whole calendar months between the hardship approval date and the handling date |
| No approval in force, and the patient holds a rental-active wheelchair (Mobility Equipment) | the rental months still left to ownership: the class's capped-rental months less the wheelchair rental months the patient's records show paid in the wheelchair's current rental period, net of any such month later reversed |
| Any other account | the class's longest arrangement in monthly installments |

**Figures of the classes used above.**

| Payer class | Capped-rental months | Longest arrangement (months) |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage HMO, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Supplement Plan G | 13 | 12 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 10 | 12 |
| Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO | 10 | 18 |

**Wheelchair months counted.** A paid wheelchair rental month counts when its service began no more whole calendar months before the handling date than the wheelchair's rental period start date; a counted month that the payer later reversed is taken back out of the count. An approval is in force while fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed since its approval date.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

1. Hardship approval dated 5 whole months before the handling date: core term 12 less 5, **7 months**.
2. No approval; Medicare Advantage PPO; wheelchair rental active, 9 paid months in the current rental period, one of them later reversed: 13 less 8, **5 months**.
3. No approval, no active wheelchair, Commercial PPO: **18 months**.
4. Hardship approval dated 12 whole months ago, no wheelchair, Medicaid Fee-for-Service: the approval is no longer in force, so **12 months**.
